admission.justification: Losing uncommitted parked or owner-written bytes, or retiring their sole restoration authority after a misleading proof, is a plausible costly error; the named transaction witnesses check the obligation before such loss can be accepted.

applicability: Ordinary sync conflicts, fresh validator stops, clean syncs, own-commit merges and code/external-memory restoration.
conditions: Genuine reapply conflicts remain retained resolution work.
Only fresh same-call staged validator output may be fingerprinted without a replay proof.
Converted memory still validates against the paired code result before its merge commits.
exclusions: No bypass of validation, cutover lock, admission, or managed landing-chain authority is introduced.

evidence: Synced freeze 231622b2c7e272e7ca182ec28d3da61ca1749e0f + tracked diff d4c93e6a94ef056ca4d5eb77d4c05d73eac6062654729e2cb979d0cfd870141f (S2 documentary correction of the S list: stale symbol spellings and the rule-1 inventory rationale corrected, all other producer fields identical); ResumedConvertedMemoryMergeTests (2 tests) in test_sync_parked_candidate.py.

statement: Genuine reapply conflicts still become the retained resolution state, staged memory-validator stops persist their operation-created state, and clean syncs, own-commit merges, and the memory cache side behave as before.
